scope: Friendly product copy and a two-page robot-led PDF guide for DaBin 0.4.19 (74). Documentation only; no production app source, installed app, user archive or settings changed.

native_visual_provenance.robot_identity: Canonical current-production Quiet Orbit RobotCharacterView; no generated replacement.
native_visual_provenance.privacy: Local native exports with a fictional temporary archive and isolated preferences. No personal captures, clipboard access, network, global input, notification delivery or permission prompts. The simple trail illustration is code-drawn fixture content, not KARI material.

visual_review.method: Both final PDF pages rendered with Poppler at 180 dpi and inspected in full. Independent read-only copy and visual review also passed.
checks: No overlapping, clipped or overflowing authored text.
Consistent embedded typography, margins, contrast, headings, footers and page numbering.
Native interface labels remain readable; numbered callouts avoid covering controls.
Project and preview callouts target real native interface regions.
PDF-only crops preserve native source pixels and frame proportions.
Friendly robot voice; first steps separated from optional capture and comfort settings.
Auto Capture is opt-in, destination-aware and limited to new changes.
Clicking an expired alarm acknowledges it; the task stays open until marked done.

preservation: Previous PDF contents and the prior builder are retained under design/onepager/archive. Existing unrelated worktree changes are preserved.
rebuild_note: A later build invalidates this review unless its output and authoring-input hashes match; inspect both new renders and update the review record.
